title: Digital detox
line: Taking some time offline to focus on me.
caption: He will be back online when the box lets him.
dog_does: A slightly chunky beagle stands in a kitchen with its entire head inside an empty cereal box, the box upright over its face, ears squashed out the sides, tail mid-wag. A few cereal crumbs on the tile, a bin with its lid open behind. Phone shot from standing height.

title: Giving back
line: Giving back to my community.
caption: Every drop went directly to the people.
dog_does: A wet shaggy gray terrier mix mid-shake in a narrow hallway right after a bath, fur flared out in a blur, ears flying, water droplets spraying in an arc; a towel dropped on the floor and a person's jeans at the frame edge speckled with water. Bathroom light behind.

title: Joy audit
line: Decluttered everything that didn't spark joy.
caption: It all sparked joy, which was the problem.
dog_does: A scruffy tan chihuahua mix sits in the middle of a living room floor blanketed with shredded white tissue, an empty crushed tissue box beside it, a scrap stuck to its nose. Head slightly tilted at the camera. Coffee table legs and a sofa skirt in frame.

title: Hydration goals
line: Three liters a day, mostly on the floor.
caption: Hydration is a mindset.
dog_does: A yellow lab, coat a bit uneven and shedding, stands with both front paws inside a steel water bowl on a kitchen floor, water splashed in a wide puddle across the tiles, a paw raised mid-slap, droplets in the air. Looks down at the bowl, not the lens.

title: Boundaries
line: Not everyone deserves access to my energy.
caption: He has asked the driver to respect his capacity.
dog_does: A scruffy black-and-white border collie mix up on the back of a sofa, front paws on the windowsill, mouth wide open mid-bark, hackles slightly up, nose smudges on the glass. Outside, slightly blurred, a delivery driver walking up the path with a box. Shot from behind the sofa.

title: Situationship
line: We're not putting a label on it, we're just getting to know each other.
caption: He says it's early days.
dog_does: At a grassy dog park, a scruffy brindle pit mix sniffs the rear of a fluffy brown doodle, both tails up, leashes slack and trailing. Wide phone shot from a few feet away, other dogs blurry in the background, a chain-link fence.

title: Radical vulnerability
line: Practicing radical vulnerability and honestly it's been so healing.
caption: He's never felt more seen.
dog_does: A fawn boxer lying fully upside down on a couch, all four legs splayed straight up, lips flopped back showing teeth, tongue sideways, eyes half open looking at the phone. A crumpled throw blanket and a remote half under him. Afternoon window light.

title: Open to feedback
line: Always open to feedback.
caption: He hears you. He's choosing growth elsewhere.
dog_does: A gray-and-white husky with a slightly scruffy shedding coat mid-enormous yawn on a kitchen floor, jaw fully open, tongue curled, eyes squeezed shut, directly facing the phone. A person's sock feet at the frame edge as if mid-lecture.

title: Carb cycling
line: Currently carb cycling. Today is the carb part.
caption: Consistency is key.
dog_does: A scruffy red heeler mix lies on a kitchen floor with a half-eaten loaf of sliced bread between its front paws, the plastic bag torn open, crumbs and a crust around it, a slice hanging from its mouth. It looks up at the phone with no guilt. Counter edge above.

title: Capsule wardrobe
line: Capsule wardrobe update: we're down to one shoe.
caption: Fewer, better pieces.
dog_does: A scruffy black lab mix puppy lies on a hallway runner gnawing a white sneaker, the toe chewed open, laces frayed, its matching shoe a few feet away also mangled. Puppy looks up at the phone mid-chew. Shoe rack by the door, out of focus.

title: Shadow work
line: Doing the shadow work nobody sees.
caption: Some of the work is private.
dog_does: A slightly overweight corgi with uneven fur stuck halfway under a low bed frame, only the back half visible: hind legs splayed, fluffy rear and stub of a tail poking out from under the bed skirt. A dust bunny and a lost sock beside him. Bedroom carpet, daylight.

title: Face mask
line: Step seven of my skincare routine: the overnight mask.
caption: Glow comes from within. Mostly the fridge.
dog_does: A scruffy white terrier mix with Greek yogurt smeared across her muzzle and whiskers, a tipped yogurt cup on the floor licked clean, tongue mid-lick on her own nose. Kitchen floor, a breakfast bowl on the counter edge above.

title: Romanticize the commute
line: Romanticizing my commute.
caption: Main road, main character energy.
dog_does: A scruffy hound mix with his head out of a moving car's rear window, jowls and ears blown back, gums flapping, eyes squinting, a trail of drool streaked along his cheek. Shot from inside the car, the window frame and a blurred suburban road outside.

title: Meal prep
line: Meal prepped for the whole week.
caption: Failing to prepare is preparing to fail.
dog_does: A scruffy golden retriever mix in a pantry doorway with its head inside a torn kibble bag, kibble spilled across the floor in a wide fan, its belly visibly round, a kibble stuck to its lip as it pulls its head out toward the phone.

title: Tiny living
line: Downsized, and living tiny has been so freeing.
caption: Less space, more peace. For him.
dog_does: A large black lab with a scruffy coat crammed into a small round cat bed, haunches spilling over the edge, one back leg hanging out, chin on the rim. The cat sits beside on the bare floor staring at him. Living room corner, daylight.

title: Speaking my truth
line: Using my voice to speak my truth.
caption: Some of us won't be silenced.
dog_does: A scruffy husky-shepherd mix sitting on a porch with head thrown back, muzzle pointed at the sky, mouth in a round O mid-howl, eyes closed. A street and a blurred ambulance light at the edge of frame.

title: Big goals
line: Big goals don't fit through small doors.
caption: He refuses to think smaller.
dog_does: A scruffy Labrador-pointer mix at an open garden gate with a huge branch clamped in its jaws, the branch jammed crosswise against both posts, the dog leaning forward, paws scrabbling on the path. Phone shot from the other side of the gate.

title: Rebrand
line: Gutted the old me for the rebrand.
caption: The old him couldn't come to the phone.
dog_does: A scruffy Boston terrier mix sitting among a cloud of white polyester stuffing on a living room rug, holding a flat, emptied plush fox skin in its mouth, stuffing stuck to its face and ears. It stares at the phone.

title: Clean girl
line: Effortless clean girl aesthetic.
caption: Beige is a state of mind.
dog_does: A scruffy Australian shepherd mix standing on a cream shag rug, legs and belly soaked in brown mud up to the chest, a trail of muddy paw prints across the rug behind it, its head and back still clean and fluffy. Bright minimal living room.

title: Leaning in
line: Leaning in.
caption: He's ready for the next level. The counter.
dog_does: A scruffy Great Dane mix with front paws on a kitchen counter, body stretched long, nose a few inches from a roast chicken on a cutting board, tongue already out. Phone shot from behind and to the side, the kitchen window above.

title: No-shampoo journey
line: Day 40 of my no-shampoo journey.
caption: His natural oils are finally balanced.
dog_does: A scruffy, slightly matted sheepdog mix at an open bathroom doorway with all four legs locked and braced, body leaning back, a filled bathtub and a towel visible behind. A person's hand holding the collar at frame edge, the dog's face turned away with a sideways eye.

title: Own research
line: I've been doing my own research.
caption: He's not saying the squirrel is involved. He's asking questions.
dog_does: A scruffy medium terrier mix with its head shoved between horizontal window blinds, slats bent around its face, one eye visible staring outside, the rest of the blinds crooked. Shot from inside the room, the dog's back half and wagging tail on a chair.

title: Multitasking
line: High performers can do three things at once.
caption: He's going for four.
dog_does: A scruffy golden doodle mix standing on a lawn with three tennis balls crammed into its mouth, jaws stretched wide, cheeks bulging, drool on one ball, eyes wide and proud at the phone. Backyard, a fourth ball in the grass beside.

title: Sustainability
line: Doing my part for sustainability by pre-rinsing everything.
caption: Small changes, big impact.
dog_does: A scruffy black-and-tan coonhound mix with its head deep inside an open dishwasher, front paws on the open door, licking a dinner plate in the bottom rack, ears hanging into the rack. Kitchen at evening, under-cabinet light.
